title: Combine monitors into one virtual display
summary: Use RandR 1.5+ to combine multiple physical monitors into a single virtual display. This allows windows to span across monitors seamlessly, similar to Xinerama but without restarting X.
prerequisites: Desktop environment supports virtual displays (e.g., Openbox works, some DEs do not).

steps.explain: List the current monitors to get their names.
steps.expect: A list of monitors with IDs and names.

steps.explain: Create a virtual display combining the listed monitors. 'auto' calculates the size automatically.

placeholders.name: VIRTUAL_NAME
placeholders.description: Name for the new virtual monitor

placeholders.name: MONITOR_LIST
placeholders.description: Comma-separated list of physical monitor names

rollback.explain: Use xrandr --delmonitor with the name you gave the virtual display.

warnings: Some desktop environments do not support this feature.
Monitor order in the command does not determine physical position; you may need to rearrange them with xrandr --output ... --right-of ... after creating the virtual display.
